competitive_landscape: Today: diesel river cruises, casino boats and informal beach launches. The pain is slow, smoky, low-quality water experiences in a premium destination — the status quo a clean foiling tier improves on.

demand_signals.note: Southern node of an India coastal network with Mumbai

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Goa's coastal and river hops (Grande Island ~12 nm, South Goa ~28 nm) sit inside the all-electric envelope over sheltered river and near-shore water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Carries the long Konkan-coast corridor to Mumbai (~220 nm) with no charging dependency.

precedents.what: A foiling-electric vessel network at national scale (~100 vessels / $100M, 3-year phasing)
precedents.why_it_matters: Proves foiling-electric works as an at-scale transfer-and-island-hopping network, not just a pilot.

regulatory_note: Goa Tourism licenses water-based tourism; India's coastal-shipping and decarbonization policy supports cleaner river and coastal passenger operations.
seasonality: SW monsoon (June–Sept) limits open-coast operation; the Mandovi river network and sheltered hops run year-round.
summary: Goa is India's premier coastal tourism state — a coastline threaded by the Mandovi and Zuari rivers with heavy river-cruise traffic and island diving. A clean foiling tier upgrades a water-built economy whose brand increasingly emphasizes sustainability.
tagline: India's tourism flagship, on the water.

signature_routes.label: North Goa ↔ South Goa — coastal corridor (Pioneer II)
